item.title: Joined Geotab
item.description: I joined Geotab as a Senior Security Researcher, working on product security.

item.title: Paper published in IEEE TDSC
item.description: Our paper, “Unveiling the Global Landscape of Android Security Updates”, has been published in IEEE Transactions on Dependable and Secure Computing.

item.title: Paper accepted at NDSS 2025
item.description: Our paper, “Speak Up, I’m Listening: Extracting Speech from Zero-Permission VR Sensors”, has been accepted for publication at NDSS 2025.

item.title: Presented at FTC PrivacyCon 2024
item.description: I had the privilege of presenting our work on Android security updates at FTC PrivacyCon 2024.

item.title: Paper accepted at USENIX Security 2024
item.description: Our paper, “EVOKE: Efficient Revocation of Verifiable Credentials in IoT Networks”, has been accepted for publication at USENIX Security 2024.

item.title: Paper accepted at NDSS 2024
item.description: Our paper, “50 Shades of Support: A Device-Centric Analysis of Android Security Updates”, has been accepted for publication at NDSS 2024.

item.title: Paper accepted at USENIX Security 2023
item.description: Our paper, “RøB: Ransomware over Modern Web Browsers”, has been accepted for publication at USENIX Security 2023.

item.title: Two papers accepted at NDSS 2022
item.description: Two papers, “A Lightweight IoT Cryptojacking Detection Mechanism in Heterogeneous Smart Home Networks” and “The Truth Shall Set Thee Free: Enabling Practical Forensic Capabilities in Smart Environments”, have been accepted for publication at NDSS 2022.
